description: Hello, we are Total. Our goal is to make life easier for farmers and agricultural producers, and one of our core strengths is solving problems.
summary: Hello, we are Total. We have developed a system that combines data from NASA satellites with ground-level information to monitor river conditions—a tool that assists the government, farmers, and agricultural producers, especially during periods of drought. Our project aims to track fluctuations in river levels and investigate why these changes occur in some regions but not others. By integrating NASA satellite data with our own ground-based systems and devices, we have achieved a near-zero margin of error. Why is this important? Our project can detect changes in a river, while the satellite data helps explain the underlying causes; this allows us to identify, for instance, whether a river is at risk of overflowing during heavy rainfall, among many other applications.
details: It measures water levels and combines this with satellite data to provide forecasts for rivers. It has an impact on the environment. Currently, we are using Scratch and information from Google to study the environment in relation to rivers.
